boundary: Measured study evidence for part-level process traceability and tool-condition/defect linkage. No raw dataset/sample-count promotion is implied.

entries.title: Smart Stamping and Injection Molding Tools by Innovative Measuring System
entries.physicalOutcome: Measured excessive cavity pressure/temperature were linked to stored defective parts including burn-mark/Diesel-effect conditions; individual part identity was linked to its process signature.
entries.limitation: Demonstrator study; no open raw production database was confirmed and the article is CC BY-NC-ND rather than a raw-data reuse grant.

reviewImpact.stillMissing: Rights-clear raw per-part traces from a sustained industrial production campaign with interventions/recovery.
